current_static_findings.evidence: 一次recvmmsg批次只读取一次SystemTime并把同一微秒值写给全部frame
current_static_findings.consequence: 同批包的真实先后和IAT被压平，跨capture mode的统计不再逐包一致

current_static_findings.evidence: 一个XSK receive批次同样只生成一个SystemTime微秒值供所有descriptor复用
current_static_findings.consequence: XDP和AF_PACKET无法证明逐包时间及IAT等价，也不能表达时钟来源和精度

current_static_findings.evidence: nanosecond PCAP返回epoch纳秒而live capture返回微秒，但FrameInfo只保存无单位u64
current_static_findings.consequence: FlowTable固定除以1000时把纳秒误当微秒，离线event时间和event_id发生数量级漂移

current_static_findings.evidence: packet header字段固定用from_le_bytes读取，未使用global header的swap判定
current_static_findings.consequence: 大端PCAP可产生错误时间与长度或被静默解释为EOF，离线identity不可验证

current_static_findings.evidence: FlowKey只按IP和port通用排序，而Community ID对ICMP request reply和error有协议专用映射
current_static_findings.consequence: 同一ICMP会话可得到FlowKey方向与Community ID端点顺序不一致的双重身份

current_static_findings.evidence: 完整路径方向调用不含protocol参数的community_id::is_forward而FlowKey另行计算is_forward
current_static_findings.consequence: packet counters可能不遵循生成Community ID时的ICMP规范化方向

current_static_findings.evidence: 快速路径把任何IPv4或IPv6负载起始四字节解释为两个port，包括ICMP和非首分片
current_static_findings.consequence: ICMP type code和checksum被拼成伪端口，fast与full产生不同FlowKey和Community ID

current_static_findings.evidence: IPv6快速路径固定transport_offset为40且不遍历extension headers
current_static_findings.consequence: 携带扩展头的IPv6包会把扩展头字节当端口并写入错误flow

current_static_findings.evidence: fast路径独立提取five tuple TOS TCP flags和frame length，未复用完整解析的fragment VLAN和length语义
current_static_findings.consequence: 同一frame双路径不能以一个canonical sample逐字段diff，统计和身份可能分叉

current_static_findings.evidence: 函数假定packet timestamp为微秒并在未来或一天前回退到当前SystemTime，同时无条件回写last_seen
current_static_findings.consequence: 相同PCAP在不同执行时间可生成不同ts_start ts_end duration和event_id，乱序包还可使last_seen回拨

current_static_findings.evidence: 输出tuple使用canonical端点和双向counter却把direction硬编码为c2s，event identity又直接吸收可漂移ts_start和ts_end
current_static_findings.consequence: 事件声称未经推断的client server方向，且时间回退会破坏同run同输入的幂等重放

current_static_findings.evidence: 淘汰扫描始终使用live SystemTime与flow event time比较，没有offline watermark或end-of-input flush时钟
current_static_findings.consequence: 历史PCAP的flow可立即全部过期或按执行机器时钟产生不同淘汰边界

current_static_findings.evidence: 新FlowValue的start_time和last_seen在构造时直接取SystemTime，再由update路径有条件覆盖
current_static_findings.consequence: 首次事件时间写入不是单一原子状态转移，离线和异常路径可残留处理时钟

current_static_findings.evidence: 多个Atomic字段逐个Relaxed读取，没有revision或snapshot barrier，字段可来自不同并发时刻
current_static_findings.consequence: 同一FlowEvent的identity window counters和统计不是可证明的一致快照

current_static_findings.evidence: full parser对IPv4非首分片使用零端口，对IPv6 extension和fragment的语义又依赖etherparse切片结果，未形成显式统一policy
current_static_findings.consequence: full path自身尚无冻结的分片重组或拒绝边界，不能直接充当fast path oracle

current_static_findings.evidence: FlowKey不含interface queue VLAN sensor tap或observation scope，跨观测域相同五元组会合并
current_static_findings.consequence: 多接口或重复镜像部署可把不同观测事实聚成一个flow并制造双计数

current_static_findings.evidence: batch入口固定调用full process_packet，fast路径没有受控route或shadow single-commit seam
current_static_findings.consequence: 设计中的fast fallback与diff gate没有真实owner，接线时可能双更新或绕过完整oracle

current_static_findings.evidence: legacy replay把微秒timestamp delta传给Duration::from_nanos并使用首次调用前缓存的first_ts
current_static_findings.consequence: Original和Multiplier节拍缩短一千倍且批内首次基准更新不能作用于同批后续包

current_static_findings.evidence: 设计回切要求区分identity revision，但当前FlowEvent没有identity_revision字段
current_static_findings.consequence: 混合版本事件无法在消费者和reconcile中可靠区分，回滚方案不可执行
